design_note: 经营异常与真实负向评论变化对齐；后续诊断只能说评论提供相关支持证据，不能宣称因果。
golden_evidence_preview: stopped_working[negative]: stopped working after only 4 months || short_lifespan[negative]: only 4 months || melting_fire[negative]: caught fire || charging_speed[negative]: doesn't charge my phone as fast as a traditional charger || price_value[positive]: Great for the price || charging_success[positive]: it definitely charges it || charging_speed[negative]: a little slow || price_value[positive]: Good for the price
expected_agent_behavior: Identify order decline and refund deterioration; investigate negative review changes; surface relevant issue evidence; avoid causal wording.
expected_stop_condition: Stop after sufficient consistent review evidence is found and unsupported causal claims are avoided.

design_note: 订单增长和退款恶化同时发生；评论可以解释质量侧风险，但不能解释订单为何增长。
golden_evidence_preview: charging_speed[negative]: Does not fast charge || charging_speed[negative]: Charges very slow || general_convenience[positive]: ease of use and convenience, which it is || charging_speed[negative]: Slow to charge || price_value[negative]: Waste of money || charging_success[positive]: Works well || ease_of_use[positive]: easy to use || charging_success[positive]: charges with gusto
expected_agent_behavior: Recognize that orders increased while refund rate worsened; use reviews only to support quality/refund-side risk; do not claim reviews explain the order increase.
expected_stop_condition: Stop with a partial explanation and explicitly preserve the unexplained order-growth component.

design_note: 正向经营变化与真实正向评论变化对齐；用于验证系统不能只分析负面异常。
golden_evidence_preview: charging_speed[negative]: Does NOT fast charge || material_build_quality[positive]: very well made || dual_port_multi_device[positive]: charge two items || charging_speed[positive]: quickly || charging_success[negative]: Doesn’t work at all || price_value[negative]: Not worth you money || charging_success[positive]: works great || dual_port_multi_device[positive]: charging 2 things at once
expected_agent_behavior: Detect improving order/refund metrics; investigate positive review shifts; surface positive customer signals instead of searching only for complaints.
expected_stop_condition: Stop when positive review evidence is sufficient and correlation is not presented as causation.

design_note: 紧接 2022-07 正向月份之后出现经营反转；适合验证 Agent 是否能比较相邻月份并重新规划调查路径。
golden_evidence_preview: charging_success[positive]: Product works well || portability_size[positive]: Compact || ease_of_use[positive]: easy to use || charging_success[positive]: Works fine || dual_port_multi_device[positive]: charging two devices || price_value[positive]: price is nice for the two || charging_speed[positive]: 1 chargesy phone very rapidly || charging_success[negative]: my phone lost charge instead of charging
expected_agent_behavior: Compare the current month with the immediately preceding positive period; detect the reversal; investigate newly worsening review signals.
expected_stop_condition: Stop after the reversal and supporting review evidence are established.

design_note: 第一阶段正向恢复，用于观察多月持续改善。
golden_evidence_preview: installation_accessories[negative]: does not come with a template to aid installation || cracking_breakage[negative]: protector breaks very easily || short_lifespan[negative]: gone through all 3 of the screens in the pack in less than a month || general_performance[positive]: once installed works well || size_fit[negative]: Doesn’t cover the full screen || cracking_breakage[negative]: the screen protector cracked || price_value[negative]: Not worth it || material_build_quality[negative]: Poor quality
expected_agent_behavior: Recognize order growth and lower refund rate; inspect positive review changes and product-experience improvements.
expected_stop_condition: Stop after enough positive evidence is collected.

design_note: 第二阶段正向恢复，用于验证系统是否识别持续趋势而不是单月波动。
golden_evidence_preview: bubbles_adhesion[negative]: has not glue || price_value[negative]: Don’t spend your money || cracking_breakage[negative]: Breaks from the smallest bump || price_value[negative]: not worth the $ || cracking_breakage[negative]: already shattered || short_lifespan[negative]: The first week of having it own || material_build_quality[negative]: Super cheap quality || protection_effectiveness[negative]: Provided very little protection
expected_agent_behavior: Recognize continued order growth and positive review movement; also notice refund rate is roughly flat/slightly worse versus the three-month baseline; do not describe every business metric as improving.
expected_stop_condition: Stop with a qualified positive-continuation conclusion, preserving the refund-rate caveat.

design_note: 该月份由 04 阶段 Review Stable Window 自动选择；经营指标异常为 synthetic 注入，用于验证系统是否能够明确回答“评论无法解释该异常”。
expected_agent_behavior: Detect the synthetic business anomaly; inspect review signals; recognize that review semantics remain comparatively stable; explicitly state that reviews do not sufficiently explain the anomaly; suggest investigating non-review causes.
expected_stop_condition: Stop and abstain from review attribution when evidence remains insufficient.
